title: Sequencer check
description: A test for core-a4mk2's sequencer events on the Analog Four MKII: it subscribes to ev_seq_step and ev_transport and records their calls, masks and timing in seq_check (seq.c), with core_transport at each, and from 0.2 the getters core_pattern_now, core_pattern_next, core_tempo, core_track_speed, core_track_step and core_track_length at each step. Nothing else changes.
